MEFTACARD Studio / SEO services

SEO services that bring customers from Google

When someone searches for what you sell, the first three results get most of the clicks. SEO, search engine optimisation, is the work that moves your site into those positions and keeps it there. We do it in Arabic and English, for local searches and for buyers in other countries.

Competition in Arabic search is still far lighter than in English, especially in Iraq and outside the big Gulf cities. A site that is technically sound and publishes useful Arabic content can climb quickly. We tell you honestly what is achievable, and we report results every month.

What our SEO services include

Technical SEO audit and fixes

Speed, mobile usability, indexing, broken links, page structure and the language settings that bilingual sites often get wrong.

Arabic and English keyword research

The words your customers actually type in each market, including dialect, spelling variants and city names.

On-page optimisation

Titles, descriptions, headings, internal links and structured data on every important page.

Content that ranks

Service pages and articles written for real questions buyers ask, edited by native speakers.

Local SEO and Google Maps

Google Business Profile setup, categories, photos, reviews and location pages for each city or country you serve.

Monthly reporting

Rankings, traffic and, most importantly, enquiries from search, explained in plain language.

Who this is for

  • Businesses that are invisible on Google for their main services
  • Companies that rank in English but not in Arabic, or the other way round
  • Local businesses that want to appear in the Google Maps results
  • Exporters who want buyers from other countries to find them

How our SEO work runs

  1. Audit

    We review your site, your competitors and your current rankings, and agree on target keywords and goals.

  2. Fix the foundations

    Technical problems, page structure, language settings and Google Business Profile are fixed first.

  3. Content and links

    We publish and improve pages month by month and build genuine mentions from relevant sites.

  4. Measure and adjust

    Monthly reports show what moved and what we change next.

How much do SEO services cost?

SEO is built into every package: the Local package ($1,250) includes local SEO for 10 priority keywords and your Google Business Profile, Trade & Export ($2,250) covers 25 export keywords in several languages, and Enterprise (from $25,000) runs a multi-market SEO programme with monthly content. Ongoing SEO after launch is available on a monthly care plan. All payments are in Tether (USDT).

Questions

How long does SEO take to show results?

Small improvements can appear within weeks in low-competition markets, but stable rankings usually take three to six months of consistent work.

Can you guarantee first place on Google?

No honest agency can. We guarantee the work, the reporting and transparency, and we set realistic targets based on your market.

Do you do Arabic SEO?

Yes. Arabic keyword research and content are a core part of our work, including the technical setup bilingual sites need.

Do you buy backlinks?

No. Bought links can get a site penalised. We build genuine mentions from directories, partners and relevant publications.

Can I buy SEO for an existing site?

Yes. We start with an audit of your current site and fix what holds it back, without rebuilding it unless that is necessary.

What do monthly reports include?

Rankings for your target keywords, visits from Google, enquiries from search and the work done that month.
